info.name: TIP Email Manager - Author through Submit, per Recipient Mode
info.description:
One self-contained flow per recipient mode - create draft -> email content -> attachment -> recipients -> preview -> submit for approval -> verify the change-request record.

Data source query under test: select ca_name, ca_type, status, email, name from em_contact where status=:status

Flows stop at 'submitted, pending approval' and leave the templates pending (so you can inspect the rows). The run halts at the first unexpected status and prints the response body.
